name: Temecula Promenade Mall
description: The Promenade at Temecula is an upscale open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of Temecula's wine country region. Featuring a sophisticated blend of popular retailers, diverse dining options, and entertainment venues, this shopping destination offers a pedestrian-friendly environment with modern architecture and landscaped walkways. The center serves as a premier shopping and social hub for both local residents and visitors exploring Southern California's fastest-growing wine destination.
demographics: The Promenade at Temecula attracts a diverse mix of families and young professionals from the growing Temecula Valley region, with median household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $110,000. The primary trade area serves Southwest Riverside County residents, including families with children and millennials drawn to the area's wine country tourism and suburban lifestyle. Visitors typically seek a blend of shopping, dining, and entertainment options in an upscale outdoor setting, with strong weekend traffic from both locals and tourists exploring Temecula's wine region.
summary: An upscale open-air lifestyle center in Temecula's wine country featuring popular retailers, dining, and entertainment in a modern pedestrian-friendly setting.
